page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features a dedicated CPU allocation with 96 physical cores and 96 vCPUs, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The processing power is delivered by the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor family, utilizing a single thread per core configuration to ensure dedicated execution resources without hyperthreading overhead.

The instance is configured with 768.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per physical core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning storage requirements must be met via network-attached volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers between the instance and other cloud resources.

Given the high memory-to-core ratio and dedicated physical cores, this instance offers high resource density for memory-intensive workloads. The absence of hyperthreading and the inclusion of dedicated cores make it suitable for predictable, high-performance computing tasks. It is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, memory-intensive enterprise applications, in-memory caching, and data processing pipelines that require substantial memory capacity alongside dedicated CPU execution.
